title: Download Queue Stall Detection (arr Stack)
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sonarr:event
| stats count as events, sum(eval(status="warning" OR status="failed")) as problems, max(_time) as last_grab by indexer
| eval hours_since_grab=round((now()-last_grab)/3600,1)
| where problems>0 OR hours_since_grab>48
| sort - problems
description: Catches when your automated download manager stalls, whether from a failing indexer or a queue that has gone quiet for too long.
value: A silently stalled download stack means your shows just stop appearing; monitoring indexers and grab recency keeps the pipeline flowing.
implementation: Forward Sonarr/Radarr events; schedule every few hours and alert on failing indexers or a stalled queue.
visualization: Table of indexers by problem count and time since last grab.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when your automatic TV and movie downloader gets stuck, so new episodes keep showing up.
